name: Koma
source:
Just when you think you'll find him in the world below, he's in the world above. He's utilised by man bees as a handyman. He's a mysterious young man who is uninfluenced by the queen bee. Koma doesn't take anybody's side.

[Based on the tanslation of the official website profile.]
